MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA 🚦

Bunsod ng isasagawang Manhole Gratings Repair, asahan ang pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko sa kahabaan ng Mindanao Avenue Northbound Diversion simula mamayang 10:00 PM, November 20, hanggang bukas ng 5:00 AM, November 21, 2025, at 10:00 PM ng November 21, hanggang 5:00 AM ng November 22, 2025.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay din ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS), Task Force Disiplina, at Quezon City Police District (QCPD) para matiyak ang kaayusan ng daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the Radha Soami Satsang Beas at Radha Soami Satsang Complex, Bhati Mines from 21.11.2025 to 23.11.2025, traffic restrictions and diversions will be in place to manage heavy crowd and vehicular movement.

📍ENTRY & PARKING:
-Entry via Bhati Mines Road only,reach before 05:00 AM.
-Adequate parking inside the complex,no parking on SSN Marg.
📍ROAD RESTRICTIONS (04:00hrs to 20:00hrs):
-HTVs restricted on Bhati Mines Road (SSN Marg – Gurugram T-Point).
-Diversions via Mandi Road – Jonapur Cut & Mallu Farm – Bandh Road Cut.
📍EMERGENCY VEHICLES:
-Free access allowed for all emergency services.
📍PUBLIC ADVISORY:
-Use public transport where possible.
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
